title: Operation participants recorded before the success check, so failed transactions attributed accounts
severity_basis: A failed transaction attributed the accounts its operations named as participants. Fixed upstream by PR #739 (9538b3ca); the linter fires at the pre-fix commit and is silent after (make lint-before-after).

entries.observed: XDR302: op.Participants() (operation accounts from the envelope) reaches participant sink participants.Add with no success check; a failed transaction changes only its fee, so attribute it to the transaction and fee-bump sources only

history.note: Created by xcc findings new from report row lint:github.com/stellar/wallet-backend@666a64d4:XDR302:internal/indexer/processors/participants.go:ParticipantsProcessor.GetOperationParticipants.

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 1 of 1 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0005.json.
